GOAL: orient before proposing; check whether append_progress exists and what repo artifacts are visible.
READ: searched catalog for progress tools; listed working dir.
OBSERVED: tools.progress.append_progress is available; no prior files read yet.
REASONING: I will inspect the local agent folder for any inherited spec/context, then commit one idea.
OPEN: which coupling position is unused by rounds 093017, 125823, 212003.

GOAL: choose a coupling position not covered by rounds 093017/125823/212003 and verify it is implementable in one frozen run.
READ: the round summary probe names (branch-geodesic-rank, tangent parallel transport, incoming cone, mobius drift, shell angle, radial volume/curvature calibration, fork angle transport, gyro target, lorentz cone, geo-shell, kappa_branch, behaviour-anchored charts); plus the scope contract and experiment policy in the prompt.
OBSERVED: every prior probe attacked successor geometry as (a) a rank/margin objective, (b) a transport/rotation of successor directions into the quantizer tangent space, or (c) a radial/shell statistic. None of them made curvature itself a measured, per-prefix-node quantity that rescales the RQ residual chain.
REASONING: the untouched position is metric scaling of the quantizer rather than geometric movement of the item. Behaviour enters as successor fanout of the items occupying a prefix node; fanout sets local negative curvature c_p; c_p sets the conformal factor lambda_p(x)=2/(1-c_p|x|^2); lambda_p rescales the RQ residual chain (amplify at encode, invert at decode). Removing behaviour freezes c_p=1, removing geometry gives c_p->0 (plain RQ sum). Exactly invertible, no new trainable constant, <1% step cost, derived clip bounds.
OPEN: none; final answer follows.

GOAL: deliver the one proposed idea for ideation_2.
READ: nothing further; this record is the final answer block.
OBSERVED: idea SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ: behaviour-derived per-prefix-node negative curvature drives the conformal factor that rescales the RQ residual chain.
REASONING: single connected pathway fanout -> c_p -> lambda_p -> residual -> SID; one run, no ablation arms trained, no sweep, no seed repeat; three switches exist in code.
OPEN: future round must implement and read Stage3 test_recall@10.
